title: CRM process based on leads
html:
1. Recording the lead by clicking the + button of the CRM menu on the home page:

  1. Qualifying the lead by clicking the various statuses; the current status is marked in green:

  1. Converting the qualified lead into a contact:

When converting, the account (existing or new) and the contact name have to be given, and the opportunity has to be set. It can be finalised by pressing the Save button.

  1. Setting the opportunity related to the lead. Different probability percentages can be assigned to the statuses (for example meet and present = 25%, negotiate = 75%):

  1. The lead is placed under the My contacts widget. Clicking it displays every interaction:

The Lead, My opportunities and My contacts records

On the records, the basic and specific data are in the left-hand column, the tasks and events on the right.

In the right-hand column you can assign tasks to the given lead (for example a phone call or an e-mail reminder):

To create a calendar event, click the Create button. The events can be viewed on the Calendar tab of the left-hand column:
